slides.purpose: Present the incomplete three-door question without the Monty Hall name or supplied host policy.
slides.successCheck: Reader can state the observed event and notices that a suggested answer may require extra rules; no response or dwell is compulsory.

slides.purpose: State the complete finite experiment and identify which assumptions matter.
slides.successCheck: Reader distinguishes always revealing an unchosen goat and offering a switch from optional fair tie-breaking.

slides.purpose: Derive unconditional switching success by enumerating three prize positions.
slides.successCheck: Reader maps the two initially wrong cases to switching wins and derives 2/3 independently of tie policy.

slides.purpose: Return to the opening after the standard explanation and expose the omitted premise rather than deny the conditional calculation.
slides.successCheck: Reader explains why the standard Monty Hall answer does not follow from the incomplete opening alone.

slides.purpose: Compute a blind host's retained masses and observation denominator.
slides.successCheck: Reader derives (1/3)/(1/3+1/6+1/6)=1/2 and identifies excluded prize reveals.

slides.purpose: Condition on numbered event D2 rather than any goat reveal.
slides.successCheck: Reader derives 1/(1+t) from t/3,0,1/3, checks t=1/2,1,0, and separates this conditional result from overall 2/3.

slides.purpose: Recover the opening answer from prior, procedure and evidence event.
slides.successCheck: Reader names the quantities that must be recalculated after a protocol or observation change.
